name: Hungry (CR +0)[3pp]
source: Book of Beasts: Monsters of the River Nations
book: Book of Beasts: Monsters of the River Nations

facets.bk: Book of Beasts: Monsters of the River Nations

body:
A hungry animal will fight harder but will not last as long in a fight.

Quick Rules: +2 to all attack and damage rolls; +2 to CMB; -2 to AC and all saves; -2 hp/HD;

Rebuild Rules: Ability Scores +4 to Strength; -4 to Constitution, Dexterity and Wisdom.
